codeReview.summary: The fix commit addresses the three targeted lifecycle robustness failures: start_service now terminates spawned children when PID-file write fails, startup PID probing now handles corrupt PID files without uncaught ProcessError tracebacks, and shutdown logic now verifies post-SIGKILL liveness before removing PID tracking.

issues.description: _stop_single_service() reports status="stopped" for any non-None stop_service() result, but stop_service() can return a result even when termination is unconfirmed (`_terminate_process` -> `(False, False)` in src/mlx_stack/core/process.py:685). This preserves PID tracking correctly, but user-facing down results can still overstate shutdown success in that edge case.

sharedStateObservations.evidence: Fix transcript skeleton (session f83be4a0-242c-4bdb-994e-11f3b376fc78) shows `Tool: Skill {"skill":"cli-feature"}` -> `Error: Skill "cli-feature" not found`; handoff `skillFeedback.suggestedChanges` repeats this mismatch. Skill file exists at .factory/skills/cli-feature/SKILL.md.
